subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Account Takeover Attacks
description: A quick win: understand Account Takeover Attacks.

hook.text: You try to log into your email and the password doesn't work. Someone changed it overnight.

buildup.text: Account takeover means a thief gains control of your existing account using stolen credentials.

discovery.text: They change the password, recovery email, and phone number — locking you out permanently.

twist.text: From your email, they can reset passwords to every other account linked to that address.

climax.text: One compromised email can cascade into losing access to banking, social media, and cloud storage.

punchline.text: Your email password is the master key to your digital life.

quiz.question: Why is email account takeover particularly dangerous?
options: It allows password resets for all linked accounts
